sourceSpecific.description:
Last-known values of the pre-configured source-specific attributes, keyed by source and then by attribute name.
A source is omitted entirely when it has no source-specific data.

type.description:
Represents the type of the address. The type is used to specify the categorization
or purpose of the address, such as registered, residential, business, or other.
The default value is `Unknown`.

country.description:
Represents the country associated with the address. The value must be a valid
ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code if provided. This property is used
to specify the country where the address is located.

postCode.description:
Represents the postal code of the address. The postal code is used to identify
specific geographic areas within a country or region and is commonly part of
the addressing system for mail delivery.

postPlace.description:
Represents the postal location or city corresponding to the address.
Typically used in combination with the postal code to identify the area
of the address. This property may be null if the information is unavailable.

street.description:
Represents the street name of an address. This property holds the specific street
information associated with the address, such as the road name. It is a part
of the standard formatting for identifying a location.

addressLine.description:
Represents a specific part or line of the address, often used to provide
additional details about the address location. This property may include
information such as building names, apartment numbers, or other
descriptive elements that complement the main street or post details.

startDate.description:
Represents the start date associated with the address. This property is
used to indicate the date from which the address becomes valid or applicable.
The value can be `null`, indicating that no specific start date is set.

endDate.description:
Represents the last date associated with the validity or applicability
of the address. This property indicates when the address is no longer
in use or relevant. If not set, the end date is considered undefined.

name.description: Name associated with the company role.

grossProfit.description: Gross profit value, representing the total revenue minus the cost of goods sold (COGS).

netProfit.description: Net-profit value derived from financial calculations.

netProfitAfterTax.description: Net profit of a financial entity after accounting for taxes.

turnover.description: Turnover value associated with financial performance.

financials.description:

The section represents a higher-level categorization of economic activities,
typically grouping industries into broader segments or divisions.

level.description:
Hierarchical level of the industry.
This value indicates the depth or position of the industry
within a structured classification framework.

not covered by primary role definitions.
